## Objective
- Build a complete, phone-friendly 3D browser racing game with eight racers, auto-acceleration/braking, steering controls, checkpoints, and varied power-ups.
- Publish it on PlayDrop and provide the link.

## Requirements
- Third-person camera follows behind and above the player’s car.
- Player controls steering only; cars drive forward and slow automatically.
- Include about eight racers, which may be bots, and checkpoint power-ups.
- Work in mobile browsers.
- User requested no clarifying questions and a brief note of assumptions at completion.

## Decisions
- Built a single-file Three.js game themed as “APEX / Neon Circuit,” with the Azure Coast circuit, three laps, seven AI competitors, touch/keyboard steering, and randomized pickup boosts.

## Work State
### Completed
- Implemented game and menus/HUD in `index.html`.
- Confirmed script syntax with `node --check`.
- Opened locally in Playwright and saved screenshots to `screenshots/latest.jpg`; the intro and race screens were visually checked.
- Added a racing start/finish gantry and adjusted the sea placement after screenshot review.

### Active
- Finish browser testing after the most recent track-scene edits.
- Publish the game on PlayDrop and provide the published URL.

### Blocked
- No PlayDrop publishing integration or credentials have been identified yet.

## Next Move
1. Reload and retest the game after the latest gantry and sea edits; check browser console and a mobile viewport.
2. Determine how to publish this repository/game to PlayDrop; publish if available.
3. Return the actual published link, or clearly state what access/integration is needed if publishing cannot be performed.

## Relevant Files
- `index.html`: Complete game implementation; currently contains all HTML, CSS, and JavaScript.
- `screenshots/latest.jpg`: Most recent local visual check (screenshot is from before latest scene edits).

# Install PlayDrop AI

Publish, update and share an HTML game from your AI agent. The public `playdrop` package contains one
`playdrop-ai` skill and a connection to `https://mcp.playdrop.ai/mcp`. Sign in to PlayDrop through OAuth.
The plugin does not install the PlayDrop CLI or the former collection of game-development skills.

The production endpoint and OAuth registration discovery are live. Provider directory approval and each provider's
production acceptance are separate checks; a public Git repository does not imply a reviewed directory listing.
Select one package per client. For local testing, use a generated development package and its endpoint throughout.

## Native agents: install the skill and MCP together

### Codex

Add the repository marketplace, then open the Plugins Directory and install PlayDrop from that marketplace:

```sh
codex plugin marketplace add playdrop-ai/playdrop-plugin
```

The repository's `.agents/plugins/marketplace.json` selects `plugins/playdrop`, the native Codex package.
For updates, run `codex plugin marketplace upgrade playdrop`, then refresh the installed plugin in the client.
See [OpenAI's marketplace guide](https://developers.openai.com/plugins/build/plugins#add-a-marketplace-from-the-cli).

### Claude Code

Run inside Claude Code:

```text
/plugin marketplace add playdrop-ai/playdrop-plugin
/plugin install playdrop@playdrop
```

If Claude Code asks you to, run `/reload-plugins`. Then sign in: run `/mcp`, select `plugin:playdrop:playdrop`,
choose Authenticate and approve the connection in your browser. Until then, `/mcp` lists PlayDrop as
"Needs authentication". A PlayDrop plugin turned on at claude.ai also loads in Claude Code when you sign in with the
same Claude account.

From your game project, run `/playdrop:publish` (add `private` to test first) or ask Claude Code to publish the game.
It replies with the game's public link. The marketplace selects `variants/claude/playdrop`. See the
[Claude Code marketplace guide](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/plugin-marketplaces).

### Antigravity

Clone the public repository, then install its native variant:

```sh
git clone https://github.com/playdrop-ai/playdrop-plugin.git
agy plugin install ./playdrop-plugin/variants/antigravity/playdrop
```

This variant supplies Antigravity's `mcp_config.json` alongside the skill. Its CLI accepts a local package directory;
see [Antigravity plugins](https://www.antigravity.google/docs/plugins).

### Cursor

Cursor Agent CLI can load the portable root plugin (verified with Agent 2026.10.01) so the publishing skill and MCP
configuration are available together:

```sh
git clone https://github.com/playdrop-ai/playdrop-plugin.git
agent --plugin-dir ./playdrop-plugin
```

Review any trust prompt and complete PlayDrop OAuth. Loading the package is separate from successful game upload.
For a tools-only connection, use the manual configuration below.

In Cursor, open Customize → MCP and add PlayDrop, or merge this into `.cursor/mcp.json` at the project’s Git root
(or `~/.cursor/mcp.json` for a personal connection). Preserve existing server entries:

```json
{ "mcpServers": { "playdrop": { "url": "https://mcp.playdrop.ai/mcp" } } }
```

Enable the server and complete browser OAuth. In Cursor Agent CLI, run `agent mcp enable playdrop`, then
`agent mcp login playdrop`. Ask the agent to read your account and list games before attempting an upload.
A nested project configuration inside another Git repository may not be selected; use the actual Git root.
See [Cursor MCP setup](https://cursor.com/docs/mcp). Public marketplace approval is a separate check.
The native provider acceptance record below states what has actually been verified.

### Grok Build

Review the public package, then install its native variant:

```sh
grok plugin install 'playdrop-ai/playdrop-plugin#variants/grok/playdrop' --trust
```

`--trust` activates the package's skill and MCP connection. Start a new session or reload plugins afterward.
See [Grok Build's installation guide](https://github.com/xai-org/grok-build/blob/main/crates/codegen/xai-grok-pager/docs/user-guide/09-plugins.md).
Grok Build, hosted Grok chat and Grok Bot are separate clients. Sign in to Grok Build itself with
`grok login --device-auth` if needed. `grok mcp doctor --json` includes plugin-provided MCP connections;
`grok mcp list` alone may omit those connections. Complete PlayDrop OAuth as well as the provider login.

### Gemini on web, iOS and Android

Open [Gemini on the web](https://gemini.google.com) with an eligible personal Google account. In Settings, open
Connected Apps (some accounts show Personal Intelligence), then Custom apps → Add. Enter
`https://mcp.playdrop.ai/mcp`, continue and sign in to PlayDrop through OAuth. Ask Gemini which games you have
on PlayDrop to check the connection. Configure on the web first, then use Gemini on mobile with the same Google
account; there is no separate PlayDrop mobile connector package.

Google currently requires a personal US account, age 18+, English and Keep Activity enabled. Work/school Workspace
accounts are not eligible. Check these conditions if Custom apps is absent; a paid plan alone does not establish
eligibility. Review the activity setting yourself before changing it. Adding a custom app does not publish PlayDrop
in Google's app catalog. On October 9, Google OAuth discovered 17 tools and Gemini Flash read the connected
PlayDrop account after explicit @PlayDrop selection. Flash also passed private create/update, retained-version
readback and browser playtesting. Pro requests stalled, and the Gemini host sometimes reported error 1076 after
successful tool completion. Check retained versions before retrying; resume an interrupted request with its original
request ID. Mobile use and public publication remain unverified. Antigravity acceptance below is a separate client test. See [Google's setup guide](https://support.google.com/gemini/answer/17209137?hl=en)
and [iOS instructions](https://support.google.com/gemini/answer/17209137?co=GENIE.Platform%3DiOS&hl=en).

### First private game and update

Once connected, ask: “Read my PlayDrop account and the upload requirements. Make a small touch-friendly HTML game
and upload it privately. Give me its game ID and playtest link.” Open the returned game, then ask for one change
using that same game ID. Test the updated version before asking to publish it. Keep the game ID and link; retry an
interrupted upload using its existing request instead of creating a duplicate. Use the feedback tool to report a
problem with the client name, failed action and returned error.

### Grok Bot on mobile

Follow [Grok Bot’s mobile setup](https://docs.x.ai/grok-bot/mobile). On October 9, onboarding offered Cursor Pro or
Link Grok Account. Linking Grok required SuperGrok, SuperGrok Plus, SuperGrok Heavy or X Premium+; Google sign-in
alone did not satisfy this requirement. An existing linked SuperGrok Heavy account subsequently reached connector
setup on Cursor Free without a purchase or new trial. On October 9, the native macOS Bot passed production OAuth,
private create/update, retained-version readback and browser playtesting. The mobile workflow remains unverified.

In a browser, open the [Cursor plugins dashboard](https://cursor.com/dashboard/plugins) with the same account as
Grok Bot. Choose **Personal**, then **Add → Custom MCP**. Set Name to **PlayDrop**, Type to **URL**, and Server URL
to `https://mcp.playdrop.ai/mcp`. Leave headers, Client ID and Client Secret blank, then select **Add MCP**.
Close and reopen **Connect Apps** in Grok Bot, then choose **Your plugins → PlayDrop → Authenticate** and complete
PlayDrop OAuth. This personal connection does not require a public marketplace listing; the directory search may
return no PlayDrop result. The dashboard’s “MCP Configured” status proves registration, not completed OAuth or uploads.
Hosted Grok chat acceptance and a Grok Build plugin installation do not validate Grok Bot.
Use [PlayDrop Web](https://www.playdrop.ai/create) if your account does not offer the required connection.

# PlayDrop Agent Plugin

[![Release](https://img.shields.io/github/v/release/playdrop-ai/playdrop-plugin)](https://github.com/playdrop-ai/playdrop-plugin/releases)
[![License: MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-MIT-blue)](LICENSE)

Publish, test and share the browser games you build with your AI agent on [PlayDrop](https://www.playdrop.ai).
Want PlayDrop to build and maintain the game for you instead? Start with [PlayDrop Cloud](https://www.playdrop.ai/create).

The plugin adds one skill, `playdrop-ai`, and a connection to PlayDrop's remote MCP server at
`https://mcp.playdrop.ai/mcp`. Sign in to your PlayDrop account through OAuth; there is no CLI or package to install.

The public PlayDrop CLI and legacy CLI-based skills are retired. Publish games through the
[PlayDrop connector](https://www.playdrop.ai/create/connectors).

## Install

- **Claude Code:** `/plugin marketplace add playdrop-ai/playdrop-plugin`, then `/plugin install playdrop@playdrop`.
  Sign in with `/mcp` → `plugin:playdrop:playdrop` → Authenticate, then run `/playdrop:publish` in your game project.
- **Codex:** `codex plugin marketplace add playdrop-ai/playdrop-plugin`, then install PlayDrop from the Plugins Directory.
- **Grok Build:** `grok plugin install 'playdrop-ai/playdrop-plugin#variants/grok/playdrop' --trust`.
- **Antigravity:** clone this repository, then `agy plugin install ./playdrop-plugin/variants/antigravity/playdrop`.
- **Replit:** [add PlayDrop to Replit](https://replit.com/integrations?mcp=eyJkaXNwbGF5TmFtZSI6IlBsYXlEcm9wIEFJIiwiYmFzZVVybCI6Imh0dHBzOi8vbWNwLnBsYXlkcm9wLmFpL21jcCJ9).
- **Gemini web, iOS and Android:** add a custom app on [Gemini web](https://gemini.google.com), then use the same
  Google account on mobile. Requires an eligible personal US account, age 18+, English and Keep Activity enabled.
  See the [Gemini guide](https://www.playdrop.ai/create/connectors/gemini); consumer runtime validation is pending.
- **ChatGPT, Claude, Lovable, Grok and other MCP clients:** add a custom connector with the URL
  `https://mcp.playdrop.ai/mcp` and OAuth.

[PlayDrop Connector](https://www.playdrop.ai/create/connectors) has a step-by-step guide for each platform:

- Agents with plugins: [Codex](https://www.playdrop.ai/create/connectors/codex),
  [Claude Code](https://www.playdrop.ai/create/connectors/claude-code),
  [Antigravity](https://www.playdrop.ai/create/connectors/antigravity).
- Hosted assistants: [ChatGPT](https://www.playdrop.ai/create/connectors/chatgpt),
  [Claude](https://www.playdrop.ai/create/connectors/claude), [Lovable](https://www.playdrop.ai/create/connectors/lovable),
  [Replit](https://www.playdrop.ai/create/connectors/replit), [Grok](https://www.playdrop.ai/create/connectors/grok),
  [Gemini](https://www.playdrop.ai/create/connectors/gemini).

[Installation](INSTALLATION.md) covers each package in detail, with dated compatibility results.

## What your agent can do

- Publish one self-contained HTML game up to 10 MiB with `upload_game`, or a built folder, ZIP or `.play` package
  with [catalogue.json](https://www.playdrop.ai/create/learn/packaging) for several files, listing art and video,
  PlayDrop SDK features and hosted servers. Your source project stays with you; PlayDrop receives built output.
- Choose who can play: private for testing, unlisted for anyone with the link, or public for discovery. Release a
  tested private version with `publish_game_version`, and update the same game later without changing its link.
- Reach players on the web and in PlayDrop's iOS, Android, Windows and macOS apps, where games play full screen.
- Add [cloud saves](https://www.playdrop.ai/create/learn/cloud-saves),
  [leaderboards](https://www.playdrop.ai/create/learn/leaderboards), sharing and invites,
  [online parties with voice](https://www.playdrop.ai/create/learn/online-party), gamepads and phone controllers,
  [hosted Colyseus servers with MongoDB](https://www.playdrop.ai/create/learn/game-servers), and optional tips,
  purchases and ads that earn the creator credits.
- Test a running local game inside PlayDrop before uploading: open
  `https://www.playdrop.ai/@<username>/<slug>/dev?url=http%3A%2F%2Flocalhost%3A5173%2F` in a browser on the machine
  that runs the local server. The Extensions panel provides Live/Draft playback of uploaded versions.
- Send questions, bugs and ideas to the PlayDrop team with the feedback tool.

Your agent reads the current guides with `get_documentation`: `{topic:"index"}` lists them all. The same guides are
on the web at [playdrop.ai/create/learn](https://www.playdrop.ai/create/learn), in 20 languages.

## Contents

- `plugin.json`, `mcp.json`, `skills/`: portable Agent Plugins 1.0 package.
- `plugins/playdrop/`: Codex native package with its registered public OAuth client.
- `variants/claude/playdrop/`: Claude Code native package with its registered public OAuth client.
- `variants/antigravity/playdrop/`, `variants/grok/playdrop/`: native client packages.
- `.agents/plugins/`, `.claude-plugin/`, `.grok-plugin/`: repository marketplace metadata.
- `server.json`: the [MCP Registry](https://registry.modelcontextprotocol.io) entry, `ai.playdrop/mcp`.

All packages point at the URL in `mcp.json`; generated development copies may point at a development service.
Version 1.0 replaced the older broad game-development plugin with one publishing skill and a remote connection.
This MIT-licensed package contains no server implementation or credentials. Never add access tokens to it.

## Objective
- Build and publish a phone-friendly 3D racing game on PlayDrop, with a more approachable circuit that still has straight sections and corners.

## Requirements
- Third-person camera, automatic acceleration, steering controls, checkpoints, power-ups, about eight racers, and mobile-browser support.
- Keep scenery clear of the track.
- Keep corners, but avoid the previous overly sharp 90° turns.

## Decisions
- The game is a single-file Three.js racer themed “APEX / Neon Circuit,” featuring the Azure Coast circuit, three laps, seven AI competitors, touch/keyboard steering, randomized pickup boosts, and a fixed north-up minimap.
- The latest circuit uses long straights connected by rounded bends.

## Work State
### Completed
- Implemented game menus, HUD, track, racers, checkpoints, power-ups, and minimap in `index.html`.
- Corrected steering direction for keyboard, touch buttons, and swipes.
- Updated scenery placement to keep buildings and palms clear of the track and one another; unsafe placements are skipped.
- Revised the circuit to retain straightaways and bring back rounded corners.
- JavaScript syntax check passed after the latest track change; earlier browser checks showed a clear road and roadside barriers.

### Active
- Publish the game on PlayDrop and provide its public link.

### Blocked
- PlayDrop publishing requires connecting its MCP endpoint (`https://mcp.playdrop.ai/mcp`) and completing OAuth; no authenticated account is available.

## Next Move
1. Visually verify the latest rounded-corner track update in the browser.
2. Connect PlayDrop MCP, complete OAuth, publish, and share the returned URL.

## Relevant Files
- `index.html`: Complete game implementation; latest circuit and scenery updates.

## Important Context
- Changes are uncommitted; `index.html` is untracked.
- The project README points to OMGithub, not PlayDrop.
